title: visual baseline regen + 5 locale + Lighthouse + a11y verify
acceptance: 触发 GitHub Actions update-visual-baselines.yml workflow: 4 viewport (Desktop 1920 / Tablet 768 / Mobile 375 / Wide 2560) × 5 locale spot check × 11 components ≈ 220 visual snap 入 git
Lighthouse Desktop logged-out 实测 6 项门槛全 PASS: perf ≥85 / LCP <2.5s / CLS <0.05 / TBT <200ms / SEO ≥90 / a11y ≥90

a11y 手动 verify 4 项: (1) keyboard nav Tab through 所有 CTA / 链接 / form (2) focus visible outline 清晰 (3) contrast WCAG AA (text vs bg ≥4.5:1, large ≥3:1, 用 axe-core 或类似工具) (4) aria-label / aria-hidden 关键交互
5 locale text overflow spot check: 抽 ja / ko (通常比 en 长 20-30%) + es 验关键 sections (hero / cards / FAQ) 不溢出 / 不换行错乱

Browser matrix check: Chrome 115+ native view transitions + scroll-driven (OK) / Safari 18+ same / Firefox latest fallback (IntersectionObserver/framer-motion 退化无 motion 但 navigation 不破) / 旧 Safari (< 18) fallback OK
prefers-reduced-motion 测: 启用系统选项后, 所有 motion 退化为静态/瞬时切换
